audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid ends 'that channel-shield tanks his return fire'. Pop Blossom has no shield — Riot's text is a preparation, a leap that knocks up, and a landing that damages and stuns. Nothing in Neeko's kit shields.
audit.why: A player who thinks the ult absorbs damage commits into a Lucian rotation expecting to survive it. What does exist and is worth the same words: while disguised, Pop Blossom's preparation is hidden, and Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 but shortens with every Lightslinger attack — so the dash comes back on his damage output, not on a clock.
audit.corrected: content.mid now counts Lightslinger double-shots instead of promising a shield.
sources: kit: Lucian E text and cd 16/15.5/15/14.5/14

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 sides Skill and 2+ items sides Lucian, while the packet chart reads Lucian at 6 and Neeko at 2+ items — and the page's own whys[6] and content.late say Neeko out-scales him and that the 69.7% 'lives here'.
audit.why: The 2+ row directly contradicts the text beside it, and the mirror has already flipped that row to Neeko. Level 6 stays his because Relentless Pursuit answers the root: 445 range, 16s at rank 1, and every Lightslinger attack cuts the remaining cooldown.
audit.corrected: win[4]/phases[4].side to Lucian and win[6]/phases[6].side to Neeko as matched pairs, ratings rescaled to 4/10 and 7/10, and whys[4] rewritten to explain the level-6 row.

audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 matches a lane Lucian owns from level 1 through 6; the 69.7% over 33 games is earned in the mid game the chart now credits to Neeko, not in lane, so the difficulty rating should not move with it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t describe Relentless Pursuit only as 'his dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown', with no numbers and no mention that its cooldown is not fixed.
audit.why: This is the one cooldown the whole page is built around and the page never says how long it is or that Lightslinger attacks shorten it. A Neeko counting 16 seconds against a Lucian who is hitting her will step up into a live dash. The range comparison matters too: Piercing Light is 500 against Blooming Burst's 800.
audit.corrected: Both now carry the 16s, the 445 range, the Lightslinger reduction and the Q range gap.
sources: kit: Lucian E text, cd 16/15.5/15/14.5/14, range 445

edits.before: Pop Blossom evens it: disguise or W-invisibility sets the ult unseen and a landed E-into-R stun trades the kill — but he can still E out, so it's a coinflip on your root.
edits.after: Pop Blossom arrives and your disguise hides its wind-up, but Relentless Pursuit is 16s and shrinks with every Lightslinger attack — he still leaves before the stun lands.

edits.before: Still his window through 4-5: he can all-in with Q-W-E and his dashes dodge your telegraphed E, so farm with Q waveclear and don't throw Tangle-Barbs on cooldown where he can sidestep it. Level 6 is where you claw even — Pop Blossom lets you ult while disguised as an ally or invisible from W, so set it unseen, land E to lock him, then R for the AoE stun-burst. Bait his E dash first; once it's down he has no way out of your root-into-ult, and that channel-shield tanks his return fire.
edits.after: Still his window through 4-5: he can all-in with Q-W-E and his dash dodges your telegraphed E, so farm with Q waveclear and don't throw Tangle-Barbs on cooldown where he can sidestep it. Level 6 closes the gap — while you are disguised Pop Blossom's preparation is hidden outright, so set it unseen, land E to lock him, then R for the AoE stun-burst. Bait the dash first: it is 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger double-shot cuts it, so count his attacks, not the clock.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W clone + disguise has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1 over 445 range, but Lightslinger attacks shorten it, so a Lucian who is hitting you gets it back early. - Piercing Light reaches 500 against your Q's 800 — poke from outside it.

edits.before: Track Lucian’s Relentless Pursuit: His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s, but Lightslinger attacks shorten it — count his double-shots, not the clock, before you throw the root.

notes: The kit's needs-antiheal flag on Lucian is a misfire and I did not write anti-heal into the page: Riot's text for Lightslinger says his attacks are empowered when an ALLY heals or shields him, which is not healing he does. Left alone on purpose: the repeated 'W invisibility' claim. Riot's Shapesplitter text in the kit describes only the third-attack damage, the move speed and the directional clone, so the file can neither confirm nor deny invisibility and I did not assert either way. Also unchanged: the full layer's 'he/his' for Neeko in the inherited template strings.
